plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Health Buddy to use the microphone so you can talk to your coach with voice input.

extra.//: Google Sign-In on Android needs no client ID in app config — the Android OAuth client is bound in Cloud Console via package name (cz.healthapp) + SHA-1 signing fingerprint. iOS needs googleIosClientId below (an iOS OAuth client bound to bundle id cz.healthapp) passed to GoogleSignin.configure, plus the matching reversed-client-id URL scheme registered via the google-signin plugin's iosUrlScheme above. googleWebClientId is only used for offline-access if ever provided; the legacy googleClientId from the browser PKCE flow is unused.
